description: Source code implementing a Tic-tac-toe game with game logic, board management, player move handling, and AI move strategy.

classes.name: Board
classes.description: Represents a 3x3 Tic-tac-toe game board with empty or marked squares.

classes.name: Game
classes.description: Represents the current state of a Tic-tac-toe game, including board, current player, mode, and computer mark.

methods.name: NewGame
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Tic-tac-toe game with an empty board, setting the first player to X.

methods.name: MakeMove
methods.description: Attempts to place the current player's mark at specified row and column, returning an error if invalid.

methods.name: GetWinner
methods.description: Checks all winning combinations to determine if there is a winner, returning 'X', 'O', or empty string.

methods.name: IsBoardFull
methods.description: Checks if all board positions are filled.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representation of the current board state with color styling.

methods.name: switchPlayer
methods.description: Switches the current player from X to O or O to X.

methods.name: positionToRowCol
methods.description: Converts a 1-9 position to zero-based row and column indices.

methods.name: GetAvailablePositions
methods.description: Returns a list of unoccupied position numbers (1-9).

methods.name: GetPlayerMove
methods.description: Prompts user to select a move from available positions, returning row and column indices.

methods.name: IsComputerTurn
methods.description: Determines if it's the computer's turn based on game mode and current player.

methods.name: GetComputerMove
methods.description: Decides the computer's move using a simple strategy: win, block, center, corner, or random.

methods.name: findWinningMove
methods.description: Checks if a winning move exists for a given mark by simulating moves.
